summary: One question on supervision r180 (adds) with r93 removed.
questions: supervision#r180 (replaces removed r93): drafted line in full: "**When** a `started` initiative that fulfils a request has neither a capability-proposal, a glossary-proposal nor a work-item, `work run` shall start a round of the kind `integrate` for it, given the accepted lines of the request it fulfils." Removed r93 was: "**When** an initiative is `started` and has neither a capability-proposal nor a work-item, `work run` shall start a round of the kind `integrate` given the accepted lines of the request it fulfils." The request's line (q35 line 1) ends at "for it"; the clause "given the accepted lines of the request it fulfils" comes from r93, not the request. Readings: (a, recommended) keep the clause as drafted; (b) end the line at "for it": "**When** a `started` initiative that fulfils a request has neither a capability-proposal, a glossary-proposal nor a work-item, `work run` shall start a round of the kind `integrate` for it."
